summary: Home Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its Q2 2026 earnings results, including financial highlights and a 3% increase in the quarterly dividend to $0.32 per share. The filing provides ordinary operational and financial updates under Items 2.02, 7.01, and 8.01, with no mention of any special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign. The dividend increase is a routine capital return adjustment. This is a standard earnings release and dividend declaration with no transformative corporate action. No special-situation category applies.
